info.description: Backend API for Teka. Every response uses the {success, data, meta, error} envelope.
info.title: Teka API

post.description: Verifies phone and password; returns an access token and sets the refresh cookie (new token family).
Revokes the refresh-token family and clears the cookie. Idempotent: succeeds without a valid cookie.
Rotates the refresh-token cookie and returns a fresh access token. Replaying an already-rotated token revokes the whole token family.

401.description: missing, expired, or revoked refresh token

post.description: Creates a teacher account from a Vietnamese phone number (0xxxxxxxxx or +84xxxxxxxxx) and returns an access token; the refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie.

get.description: status filters the list: active (default), archived, or all.

parameters.description: name, start_date, or created_at; - prefix for desc
parameters.name: sort

post.description: Schedules are required — a class without a timetable generates no sessions.

put.description: Edits name, dates, and default price; schedules and status have their own endpoints.

delete.description: Soft delete for mistakes; blocked with 409 while open enrollments exist — archive instead.

post.description: Keeps the class in history and reports; use delete only for classes created by mistake.
Adds a weekly slot; effective_from defaults to the class start date.

put.description: For correcting a mistyped row or closing it via effective_to; real timetable changes should close the old row and add a new one.

get.description: Paginated; query matches full_name or phone case-insensitively.

parameters.description: full_name or created_at, - prefix for desc
parameters.name: sort

delete.description: Soft delete; blocked with 409 while live students still reference the contact.

parameters.description: true = open only, false = ended only
parameters.name: active

parameters.description: started_on or created_at; - prefix for desc
parameters.name: sort

post.description: unit_price is copied from the class's default_unit_price server-side and cannot be supplied. started_on defaults to today and is stored verbatim — mid-cycle joins are expected.

parameters.description: student, class, and optional start date
parameters.name: request

delete.description: For enrollments created by mistake. A student leaving is an end, not a delete.

post.description: ended_on defaults to today. Ending an already-ended enrollment returns 409 so a double-submit cannot move the departure date.

put.description: Updates full_name and timezone only; other fields are ignored.

get.description: class_id filters through open enrollments — the attendance screen's class roster.

parameters.description: only students with an open enrollment in this class
parameters.name: class_id

parameters.description: full_name or created_at; - prefix for desc
parameters.name: sort

post.description: The field list is closed by design: full name, contact, and the attendance disambiguator.

422.description: validation failed, including a contact that is not yours

delete.description: Scrubs the student's personal data and ends open enrollments; invoices keep their name snapshot.

effective_from.description: EffectiveFrom defaults to the class start_date when absent.

started_on.description:
StartedOn defaults to today when absent. It is stored exactly as
given — never snapped to a month boundary or the class start date.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
